units.source_text: 对于尚侍胧月夜，他还是没有断念。

en.t: He still had not given up his feelings for Oborozukiyo, the Naishi no Kami.

units.source_text: 为她闯了大祸，犹不自惩，总想和她再会一次。

en.t: Though he had brought great trouble on himself because of her, he still had not learned his lesson and kept longing to see her once more.

units.source_text: 但那女的自从遭此忧患之后，深自警戒，不敢像从前那样与他交往了。

en.t: But ever since that woman had suffered through this distress, she had become deeply cautious and no longer dared to associate with him as she had before.

units.source_text: 源氏公子一筹莫展，觉得这世间太不自由了。

en.t: Prince Genji was at a complete loss and felt that this world was far too constrained.
